why: A small file is hashed only where a check reads it anyway: a .vscode/tasks.json, a font file or a build config. Anything else under 10 MB is not, so a known small loader script elsewhere is not found by its hash, the print.cjs dropper included. This case pins that limit so it is a decision and not a surprise (ADR-0045). Hashing every small file would make a home folder scan read every file it lists.
